_about: Blocks and lots (v0.14, src/blocks.js). A block is zoned land enclosed by lanes, the shore, the piazza and unbuildable ground. Its lane edges are cut into lots: fronts exactly along the lane, sides square to it, as deep as the middle of the block or the band's maximum. Bands by land value (walking effort to the harbour): dense near the shore, looser up the hill.
_coverage: share of a block's land covered by houses once it has filled (tests check the harbour band)
_maxFall: a lot whose ground falls more than this (m) is cut into a front and a rear house
